findings.label: Congregation chords-ON alignment change
findings.detail: The chords-ON lyric row is left-aligned monospace (Consolas/Courier New) rather than the centered Segoe UI of the chords-OFF path. This is inherent to column-aligned chord-over-lyric rendering and is not a regression of the chords-OFF path, but it is a visible layout shift on the congregation output that should be consciously accepted.

findings.label: Stale generated artifact references removed NextSlidePreview
findings.detail: obj/Release/net8.0-windows/Views/OperatorWindow.g.cs still names the removed NextSlidePreview control. It is a build output that regenerates on rebuild; no source reference to NextSlidePreview remains in the Presenter project. No action required.
